_doc: T9: optional parts of an install. ONE list read by install.sh (question, compose override, apply steps), verify_install.sh, `dfir modules` and tg-i18n (hides the buttons of a switched-off module and refuses their taps). MODULES_OFF in state/install_answers.env = space-separated ids; unset or empty = everything on (an existing install behaves as before). size_gb = measured on the reference install 12.11.2026 (docker image ls / file sizes), what is NOT downloaded when the module is off. callbacks: exact callback_data, or a prefix followed by ':'. images = image repositories used ONLY by this module: removed when it is switched off (the shared tools-sidecar image is never listed).

uses the tools-sidecar image the core needs anyway: frees RAM/CPU and the LLM, not disk
